title: D-052 street-width classification-policy layer: pure module consuming the accepted 24-class classifier (B5 implementation half; preconditions typed, geometry matching deferred to B3/B4)
objective: Implement the owner-approved D-052 DRAFT street-width classification policy as a NEW pure module services/api/app/connectors/dcm_street_width_policy.py (sibling of the accepted, unmodified dcm_street_width_classifier.py) plus its test file: consume the accepted classifier's 24 typed classes + raw label and produce a typed policy decision per D-052 - (R001) 75-ft threshold, <75 narrow / >=75 wide, with applicable-zoning-exceptions-checked as a TYPED PRECONDITION input (exceptions_checked attestation; absent or false -> UNRESOLVED, never silently thresholded); (R002) classification issues ONLY when the caller supplies documented source, street-status and frontage-coverage attestations (typed precondition object; a bare nearest-centerline match MUST be refused - frontage matching itself is the later B3/B4 geometry work); every classification carries the owner-approved-assumption wording, never a DCP-guarantee claim; (R003) one-sided-bound rule: classify iff ALL values permitted by the accepted reading fall on one side of 75 (owner examples as literal test cases: '<75' narrow; '>75','>=75','75-90' wide; '<=75','60-75','70-80' UNRESOLVED); (R004) approximations, probabilistic wording, conflicts, unclear coverage, unrecognized text -> UNKNOWN routed to map resolution; NEVER invent tolerances, average, round across the threshold, or endpoint-pick (negative tests for each forbidden move); (R005) output preserves the provenance quintuple (original label, source version, matched geometry ref, interpreted bounds, classification reason); (R006) UNKNOWN stays the underlying data state - the module emits data states, consuming rules justify their own fallbacks (D-051-R003); (R007) tests cover threshold boundaries, range handling, frontage-mismatch refusals, exception-unimplemented UNRESOLVED; all outputs DRAFT-labeled until G6. Zero new dependencies; the accepted classifier and connector modules are READ-ONLY; run cd services/api && python -m ruff check . before finishing (api CI step 1).
business_reason: Owner directive D-052 ('Record this decision and implement it through the existing project controls') - wave-4 slot 2, disjoint from M4-T018; unblocks B4/B7 wiring by giving the geometry lane a decided, tested policy surface.

services/api/tests/connectors/test_dcm_street_width_policy.py (NEW: threshold boundaries 74.99/75/75.01; every R003 owner example verbatim; negative tests per R004 forbidden move; precondition-refusal tests; provenance-quintuple schema tests; UNKNOWN propagation)

acceptance_scenarios.input: pytest over the new test file
acceptance_scenarios.expected: 74.99->narrow-eligible, 75.0/75.01->wide-eligible (subject to preconditions); every D-052-R003 owner example passes as written: '<75' narrow; '>75','>=75','75-90' wide; '<=75','60-75','70-80' UNRESOLVED; property honored: classify iff the accepted reading's interval is a subset of (0,75) or [75,inf)

absent or false source/street-status/frontage-coverage/exceptions-checked attestations -> the module REFUSES to classify (UNRESOLVED with reason), incl. an explicit bare-nearest-centerline refusal case; no default-true precondition anywhere
'~75' and probabilistic wording stay UNKNOWN (no invented tolerance); '60-75' never endpoint-picked; no averaging path exists; no rounding across 75; conflicting inputs -> UNKNOWN

every decision carries the provenance quintuple (original label, source version, matched-geometry ref, interpreted bounds, reason), the owner-approved-assumption wording on classifications, and the DRAFT-until-G6 label; UNKNOWN is a first-class data state distinct from narrow

acceptance_scenarios.input: git status + full connector suite + ruff
acceptance_scenarios.expected: exactly two new files; the accepted classifier/connector byte-unchanged; cd services/api && python -m ruff check . EXIT 0; existing connectors suite still green; zero new dependencies

risks: classification semantics drift: the module must implement the D-052 text, not a paraphrase - G3 reviews code-vs-directive fidelity line by line
precondition theater: attestation flags that callers can trivially default to true would gut R002 - the type design must force explicit caller assertions with provenance
boundary semantics: exactly 75 is WIDE (R001); '>=75' and '75-90' include 75 on the wide side - a naive strict-inequality implementation would misclassify the threshold
the module must not import or wire any rule/consumer (B7 is later); UNKNOWN emission vs rule fallback separation (D-051-R003) must stay clean
